newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BANKS CHANGE ACCOUNTS NUMBERING IN NEW YEAR.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BANKS CHANGE ACCOUNTS NUMBERING IN NEW YEAR.

text.p: A sweeping change in the way bank accounts are coded and numbered, needed to adjust Polish standards to those of the European Union, will keep the country's bankers busy over the New Year.

The changeover required by the central bank directive as of January 1, 1997, will force the country's largest savings Bank Powszechna Kasa Oszczednosci BP (PKO BP) to stay closed until January 3, a deputy head of bank's public relations department said.
Malgorzata Wyznikiewicz told Reuters that for a bank with an elaborate network of more than 900 branches, the main challenge was to change the bank's whole information system.
"This is a difficult operation for us as Poland's biggest retailer," Wyznikiewicz said.
The state-owned PKO BP will keep its offices closed from 1400 GMT on December 31, 1996 until January 3.
But its securities house will be open on January 2 to allow its clients take part in the bourse session.

Another leading state-owned universal bank Bank Polska Kasa Opieki SA (Pekao SA) will reopen on Thursday afternoon and will accept old account numbers together with the new ones until the end of next year to limit inconvenience to its customers.

Another state-owned bank Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA, one of the few institutions which have undergone the operation ahead of the January 1, 1997 deadline, said preparations for the change took it about six months.
"Our staff used the long weekend in May to avoid disruption to service but the overal preparations...took us about half a year," PBK spokesman Marek Klucinski said.
He said that up to 30 percent of the bank's employees were involved in the introduction of the new system.
Bankers said the costs of the whole operation were hard to estimate although especially staff costs were significant.

"Costs are...significant as work over the changes involved a big group of our staff for the recent months," said Tadeusz Kuranowski, head of the computer systems department at Pekao SA. -- Krzysztof Wojcik +48 22 653 9700
